name: @mxlang/core
description: MX core: parses and lowers .mx templates to a host-independent IR, shared by every target

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && bun build src/index.ts --outdir dist --target node --format esm --external @marko/compiler --external @babel/code-frame --external @babel/core --external @babel/generator --external @babel/parser --external @babel/plugin-transform-typescript --external htmljs-parser --external cosmiconfig --define MX_MARKO_FRONTEND='"./marko-frontend.cjs"' && bun build/frontend.ts && bun build/third-party-notices.ts && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json --emitDeclarationOnly --outDir dist
